text:
Maya (CS): heads-up — NewBridge flagged a new Productization team that wants to go live in 3 weeks. They expect to onboard a pipeline that will hit ~3x current throughput. asking for coordination on capacity and enablement.
Liam (Solutions): @Maya any numbers we have today vs expected? model(s) they plan to run?
Maya (CS): current steady qps ~25, daily tokens ~2.4M. they project qps ~80 peak, daily tokens ~7.5M once onboarding + realtime enrichment enabled. primary model: open-xxl-ish (2.7B opt), seq len 2k typical, KV cache hit ~30%.
Deepa (SRE): rough first pass — 25 -> 80 qps is nontrivial but doable with batching & caching tweaks. need bucketed tail latency targets from them (p95/p99). can we get a sample traffic trace?
Maya (CS): will get trace from NewBridge Amy today. she also mentioned a second use case: background embedding jobs for search that will run nightly (big batch).
Connor (Acct Exec): renewal check — their contract is up in 3 months. if onboarding stalls or costs spike they might re-evaluate. priority: smooth ramp and transparent cost estimates.
Liam (Solutions): two immediate asks from my side: 1) confirm model variant we recommend (quantized vs fp16) 2) estimate Dedicated pilot size (gpus, slots) for 4-week ramp.
Deepa (SRE): agree. also recommend we prepare a fallback routing policy: if latency >200ms p95, route to smaller variant (open-large). that'll keep UX stable.
Maya (CS): noted. I'll propose a 30-min kickoff Thurs 11am PT with NewBridge engineering, Solutions, and SRE.
Liam (Solutions): I'll bring a draft config for batching params + cache TTLs.
Deepa (SRE): can someone share recent perf profiles for the 2.7B opt? I want kernel-level numbers for seq=2k so we can simulate.
Maya (CS): attaching quick slice of their usage (pasted):
```
2026-03-18 00:00 - tokens/day: 2.4M
2026-03-18 12:00 - qps: 18 (baseline), bursts to 35
Projected Post-onboard: qps peak 75-90, sustained 40-60
Nightly batch embeddings: ~4M docs -> estimate 10M embed ops
```
Liam (Solutions): perfect — that nightly job is a big driver for Dedicated sizing. might recommend separate pool for batch so realtime pool stays snappy.
Connor (Acct Exec): btw finance asked for a high level cost delta for both hosted + dedicated options to present to their CFO. can we give a ballpark by EOD Friday?
Deepa (SRE): I can do an infra-level ballpark if I get target latency SLO + percent cache hit assumptions.
Maya (CS): asked Amy for SLOs and trace. also flagged enablement items: onboarding doc, SDK examples for streaming + reconnect, and runbook for throttling.
ops-bot: [usage-alert] NewBridge projected daily token increase >2x in next 14 days — triggered by customer intake form.
Liam (Solutions): action items: (1) Deepa: perf sim + Dedicated sizing estimate by Fri EOD (2) Me: draft batching + model fallback config before kickoff (3) Maya: collect SLOs + traffic trace, schedule kickoff.
Maya (CS): thanks team — I'll post meeting invite and paste Amy's trace when received. tagging @Connor so you're looped on renewal risk. :thumbsup:
Connor (Acct Exec): thanks, will prep exec note re: renewal and expectation setting.
Maya (CS): small note — also requested a short enablement session for their infra team during week 2 of onboarding. please keep availability flexible. :calendar:
